results.title: Microsoft struggling to restore service as global outage affects Outlook and Teams
results.content: Microsoft is struggling to fix a major global outage of its service that is reportedly affecting tens of thousands of users.

results.title: Ghana must modernise economy to meet growing population’s needs – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says Ghana must reshape its economy to support 35 million people and create decent jobs, rather than rely on temporary employment programmes.

results.title: Ghana’s economy would have crashed in 2026 without tough decisions – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says Ghana’s economy would have crashed in 2026 if the government had not taken tough decisions to restrain spending and restore discipline in public finances.

results.title: ‘How many economies would NDC build in Ghana within four years?’ – Afenyo-Markin
results.content: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin has questioned the government’s New Economy agenda, demanding clarity on how it differs from the promised 24-hour economy and how it will deliver jobs.

results.title: Recruitment stampede: Military rejects claims it abandoned injured victim, cites GH¢143,800 support
results.content: The Ghana Armed Forces (GAF) has rejected suggestions that it has abandoned Sandra Baafi Boateng, one of the victims of the military recruitment stampede at the Baba Yara Sports Stadium in Kumasi, detailing medical and financial assistance provided to her and her family since the incident.

results.title: Minority caucus demands jobs and recruitment funding, challenges call for patience
results.content: The Minority caucus has demanded clear funding for jobs and public-sector recruitment, rejecting the government’s appeal for patience after presenting the 2027 Budget.

results.title: [Video] Ato Forson breaks down 2027 Budget on JoyNews’ PM Express
results.content: Finance Minister, Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, has explained the key policies, spending priorities and economic measures contained in the 2027 Budget on JoyNews’ PM Express.

results.title: Minority caucus questions women’s bank pledge, alleges silence in 2027 Budget
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has questioned the government’s commitment to establishing a women’s bank, alleging that the 2027 Budget failed to address a promise repeated in the previous two budgets.

results.title: NDC disqualifies 23 aspirants for Dec 19 national executive elections; 98 cleared
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has cleared 98 aspirants to contest its national executive elections scheduled for December 19, 2026, following a two-day vetting exercise.

results.title: 2027 Budget offers figures, not relief for struggling Ghanaians – Minority caucus
results.content: The Minority in Parliament says the 2027 Budget fails to address the hardship facing Ghanaians, arguing that the government’s economic figures offer little comfort to people struggling with food prices and unemployment.

results.title: ‘Stability on paper, hardship in our pockets’ – Minority caucus attacks 2027 Budget
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has criticised the 2027 Budget, arguing that the government’s claims of economic stability have not translated into affordable food, jobs or relief for businesses.

results.title: Fourteen dead after truck loses control in 23-vehicle crash in UAE
results.content: Fourteen people have been killed and dozens injured after a truck driver lost control and hit several vehicles in Fujairah, in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the interior ministry has said.

results.title: Government sets 2027 deadline for local refining of 70% of small-scale gold
results.content: The government plans to ensure that at least 70 per cent of Ghana's artisanal and small-scale mining gold is refined locally by December 2027, as part of efforts to retain more value from the country's mineral resources.

results.title: Two remanded over murder of woman who travelled to recover GH¢19,000 debt
results.content: Two persons have been remanded into prison custody by the Dambai Magistrate Court for their alleged involvement in the murder of a 39-year-old woman, Rejoice Sena Akpaku, whose body was discovered in a bush near Adumadum in the Oti Region.

results.title: 2027 Budget: GH¢40.3bn allocated to Health Ministry for hospitals, NHIS and healthcare delivery
results.content: The government has allocated GH¢40.3 billion to the Ministry of Health in the 2027 Budget to strengthen healthcare delivery, expand medical infrastructure and support health workers and institutions across the country.

results.title: Volta NDC urges Minority to stop attempts to smear Ablakwa with scandals
results.content: The Volta Regional branch of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) has urged the Minority in Parliament and the New Patriotic Party (NPP) to stop what it describes as attempts to smear Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa with scandals. Volta Regional NDC Chairman, Mawutor Agbavitor, accused the Minority of pursuing an agenda to discredit and […]

results.title: Teacher trainees, BECE candidates and basic schools get GH¢562m in 2027 Budget
results.content: The government has allocated a combined GH¢562 million to support teacher trainee allowances, Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE) fees and the Capitation Grant in the 2027 Budget.

results.title: Ghana to establish convention bureau in 2027 to attract global conferences – Ato Forson
results.content: The Finance Minister, Dr Cassiel Ato Forson, says the government will establish a professional convention bureau in 2027 to attract and secure recurring African and global conferences as part of efforts to make Ghana a leading destination for international business tourism.

results.title: Owabi water treatment plant shut down after heavy rains disrupt production
results.content: The Owabi water treatment plant in the Ashanti region has been temporarily shut down, cutting supplies to parts of the Greater Kumasi metropolis.

results.title: NDC General Secretary aspirant sues party over exclusion from election after paying GH¢80k nomination fee
results.content: An aspiring NDC General Secretary, Stephen Donkor, has taken the party and its Director of Elections and IT, Mahdi Gibrill, to court over his exclusion from the list of successful nominees for the party’s internal elections.

results.title: They planted juju in my jacket at Davido’s house – Peruzzi
results.content: Singer Peruzzi said a charm was planted in his jacket while he was at Davido's house.

results.title: Government targets local production of up to 80% of essential medicines by 2030
results.content: The government is planning to amend public procurement laws to ensure that state institutions prioritise medicines manufactured in Ghana when making purchases with public funds.

results.title: Gov’t to exempt solar panels and batteries from import duties – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has announced plans to exempt solar panels and batteries from import duties and Value Added Tax (VAT) as part of efforts to reduce the cost of renewable energy and encourage more households and businesses to switch to solar power.

results.title: Ato Forson announces GH¢3.4bn for Gender Ministry, GH¢2.1bn for School Feeding Programme
results.content: The government has allocated GH¢3.4 billion to the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection in the 2027 Budget to strengthen social protection programmes and support vulnerable individuals and households across the country.

results.title: Gov’t to amend procurement laws to prioritise Made-in-Ghana uniforms, textiles – Ato Forson
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has said the government will amend the public procurement laws to compel public institutions to purchase uniforms, hospital textiles, bedding and protective clothing for security agencies exclusively from Ghanaian textile and garment manufacturers.

results.title: Government to invest $300m in National AI Centre, upgrade rural 2G networks to 4G
results.content: The government is expected to spend GH¢389.2 billion in the 2027 financial year, with substantial allocations directed towards infrastructure development, capital projects and key economic transformation initiatives.

results.title: Government pilots electronic bed management system to tackle no-bed syndrome
results.content: The government is introducing an electronic bed management system to improve the coordination and availability of hospital beds, particularly in emergency units, as part of efforts to address Ghana’s persistent no-bed syndrome.

results.title: Ato Forson announces GH¢2.26bn allocation to justice sector, NIA and Nsawam Prison
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has announced a combined allocation of approximately GH¢2.26 billion to key institutions responsible for the administration of justice, legal assistance, custodial infrastructure and national identification in the 2027 Budget.

results.title: Government allocates GH¢10m for journalists’ welfare, training and investigative reporting
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has announced an allocation of GH¢10 million to support the welfare and professional development of journalists, as well as strengthen investigative journalism in Ghana.

results.title: Government targets West Africa’s top spot for conferences, business tourism
results.content: Government says it is targeting to make Ghana West Africa's leading destination for international conferences and business tourism as part of a US$1 billion investment in the tourism, culture and creative arts sectors.
